title: Use creature metaphors only when they fit
rule: Do not add creature metaphors unless they fit the author’s meaning. Ex. Goblins
example: Keep the goblin in a fantasy scene that already features goblins.
counterexample: Add “the latency goblin” to a plain performance report.
rationale: A metaphor should fit the writer’s meaning and context.
evidence: Migrated from existing repository guidance: `deslopify/ne-fac/_template/models/openai/general.md`. Examples are illustrative.
